description:
Some journeys begin with applause. Others begin in silence. Before millions discovered Bharat Chandak's music, he spent months sharing his songs with little to no response. Yet he kept creating, driven not by recognition but by his love for music and his belief that it was worth sharing.
In this heartfelt TEDx talk, Bharat reflects on the unexpected moment that changed everything, the viral video that introduced his music to millions. Through stories of perseverance, self-belief, and the impact of touching even a single life, he reminds us that meaningful work is not measured by numbers but by the difference it makes.
This talk is for anyone who has ever wondered whether to keep going when no one seems to notice. Bharat Chandak is a rising youth icon known for blending music, storytelling, and motivational expression to connect with young audiences. Through his energetic performances and digital presence, he inspires people to pursue passion, creativity, and self-belief. His performan
title: Silence, Song, and Echo | Bharat Chandak | TEDxKKWIEER

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How do you stay true to your identity in a world that constantly expects you to fit a certain mold? Finding your authentic voice is not just about standing out—it is about unapologetically owning your story. In this powerful and deeply personal talk, multi-faceted artist and media personality Samriddhi Rai unpacks the journey of self-discovery and the courage required to express who you truly are. She shares how embracing vulnerability and breaking away from societal expectations can empower you to craft an identity that is uniquely your own.

Samriddhi Rai is a celebrated Nepali singer, songwriter, journalist, and vlogger. From representing Nepal on international pageant stages to making her mark in journalism and the music industry with empowering anthems, she has worn many hats throughout her career. Known for her storytelling and advocacy for self-love and women's empowerment, she uses her platform to inspire others to live boldly and authentically.

This talk was given at a TEDx
title: Self-Expression and Identity | Samriddhi Rai | TEDxSoftwarica College

description: Moving from the wide-open nature of California to Seoul, Hoyeon Koo was deeply struck by the everyday scene of almost everyone being constantly glued to a screen, even during the briefest moments of waiting or traveling. Pointing out that we spend a quarter of our waking hours staring down at our phones, she challenges our modern habit of filling every free minute with digital noise and questions what we truly lose when we forfeit the moments of "doing nothing." Her talk reminds us that actively choosing to put down our devices and reconnect with our physical surroundings is not a waste of time, but a refreshing superpower that allows us to fully experience the real world right in front of us Hoyeon Koo is a Grade 6 student who grew up in California before recently returning to Korea. The contrast was striking: where she once enjoyed wide open spaces and time in nature, she found people in Seoul glued to their screens even in the briefest moments between destinations. title: How a Walk to School Can Change Your Day | Hoyeon Koo | TEDxSeoul Youth

With a community of over 155,000 YouTube subscribers and a blog reaching 50,000+ monthly readers, he shares practical insights on AI, SEO, SaaS, affiliate marketing, and digital growth. title: "The experiential journey". | Dr. Ananya Biswas | TEDxSAGEUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description: True peace isn’t simply the absence of conflict, but a profound state of being found in the most unexpected of places. This talk explores the core of the humanitarian mindset, a perspective forged through years of responding to global crises, from the frontlines of pandemic situation of COVID-19 ICUs to witnessing the unfathomable depths of suffering in Gaza. The harrowing reality that even those who dedicate their lives to helping are lost on both sides of a conflict raises a haunting question: when humanity itself feels broken, how can we differentiate between lives? Through stories of loss, resilience, and the sacrifices of Humanitarian Organizations like Red Cross Red Crescent colleagues and friends, this talk reveals that every life matters. Peace, therefore, emerges from the unyielding courage to uphold neutrality and impartiality, from the compassion to heal, and from the persistent hope that, even in the darkest moments, shared humanity can light the way. - Ex-Manager of Skill
title: Finding PEACE in UNUSUAL Things | FAHAD RAHMAN AJHOR | TEDxKhulna University

In this compelling TEDx talk, Madina Maishanu explores how asking difficult questions is one of the most powerful tools for creating change. Drawing from her frontline experience as an investigative journalist, she reveals why progress begins with curiosity, courage, and the willingness to speak up—even when the answers are uncomfortable. She argues that societies move forward when women are empowered not only to find their voices but also to ask the questions that others are afraid to raise.

Through powerful stories from the newsroom and beyond, Madina demonstrates how questioning the status quo uncovers hidden truths, exposes injustice, and inspires action. Her message is a call to reject silence, challenge outdated norms, and recognize that every meaningful transformation begins with a single courageous question.

title: The dangerous power of a woman who questions everything | Madina Maishanu | TEDxMaitama Women

description:
What if art could change the way we see the natural world? Wildlife illustrator and conservation storyteller Sangeetha Kadur believes it can. Through intricate illustrations, immersive field experiences, and compelling narratives, she transforms wildlife into something deeply personal and impossible to ignore. Her work invites us to pause, observe, and rediscover the fragile beauty of the ecosystems around us. In this talk, Sangeetha explores how creativity can become a powerful tool for conservation, empathy, and action. Discover how art can bridge the gap between people and nature, inspiring a generation to protect the wild before its stories fade. There are those who tell stories in words, but only a few who tells them through the wild.
Wildlife artist and conservation storyteller, Sangeetha, has spent years bringing nature closer to home with illustrations, field observations and stories that make people stop and look closer. Her work is motivated by curiosity, patience and a quie
title: Drawing a connection to nature | Sangeetha Kadur | TEDxBITBangalore

description:
As We Start Tomorrow with AI in África and Ethiopia | Amadou Daffe | TEDxArada

What role will África play in shaping the future of artificial intelligence?

In this talk, Amadou Daffe, CEO and Co-founder of Gebeya, explores the opportunities and challenges AI presents for África and Ethiopia. Drawing from his experience building technology for African businesses, he considers how AI could help address challenges in employment, food, shelter, and healthcare.

Amadou argues that Africa’s future in AI will depend not only on talent, but on access to the tools, infrastructure, and opportunities needed to put that talent to work.

He also examines Ethiopia’s potential to become an important AI hub and calls for a future in which African talent is not simply participating in the AI revolution but helping shape it.

title: As We Start Tomorrow with AI in África and Ethiopia | Amadou Daffe | TEDxArada

author: TEDx Talks
description:
"Meu filho, o nome disso é bondade. Seja sempre assim."

Foi com essa frase da mãe, aos oito anos de idade, que Henrique Castro começou uma jornada que o levaria de uma infância marcada por internações e quadrinhos até o trabalho nas maiores instituições de socorro humanitário do mundo.

Nessa palestra no TEDxFortaleza, Henrique — especialista em desastres, psicólogo e fundador do coletivo Mentes Que Voam — compartilha as lições que aprendeu enfrentando grandes crises e as pequenas vulnerabilidades do dia a dia. Entre elas: cuidar de si também é cuidar do outro, doar o que te transborda (e não apenas o que te sobra), praticar a empatia cognitiva de perguntar antes de agir, e lembrar que o bem começa em casa.

Uma palestra sobre coragem, propósito e o convite mais simples e mais difícil de todos: apenas seja.

No espírito das "ideias que merecem ser espalhadas" o TED criou o TEDx. TEDx é um programa de eventos organizados localmente, que reúnem pessoas para compartilhar uma experiência
title: O que ninguém te contou sobre fazer o bem | Henrique Castro | TEDxFortaleza

author: TEDx Talks
description: Why does what we see make us feel a certain way? Keshav Mongia reveals the hidden power of visual language - how it speaks directly to the subconscious through schemas, how political marketing has exploited this, and how globalisation has flattened cultural schemas and meaning. It raises the question of what responsibility that places on designers. Design, it turns out, was never just decoration - it's a conversation happening beneath the surface of everything you see. Ironman athlete and Designer This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The hidden visual language beneath everything you see | Keshav Mongia | TEDxUniversity of Sussex

description: The creative process is what turns a raw idea into a unique finished product that didn’t exist before. Our brains collect and store memories, then combine them to fulfill a vision. It isn’t just limited to the arts—Creativity exists in technology, business, sports, even relationships. Creativity is problem solving. Creativity is innovation. And, creativity is something you can learn. This talk demystifies the creative process by breaking down the science and the steps that Dave Steck uses to create so that you can use them too. What’s something new that you want to bring into the world? That’s what you should create. If not now, when and if not you, then who? It’s all possible when you engage the creative process. Dave Steck is a New York City-based filmmaker and contemporary artist with a practice that combines creativity and technology to tell stories that connect with viewers across a wide range of formats and mediums. title: Engaging the creative process | Dave Steck | TEDxCUNY
